hero.sub: Intelligent property valuations powered by real estate data, market insights, and explainable AI.
intro.title: Real estate decisions deserve better intelligence.
intro.p1: KSHETRA reads a flat the way a valuer does. It looks at what similar homes nearby are asking, what the same building is asking, and how size, floor and furnishing move the price. Then it tells you what it found.
intro.p2: Every estimate comes with a range, the factors that pushed it up or down, and the listings it was built from. If the evidence is thin, it says so instead of guessing.
intro.fine: Measured on listings the model never saw during training. Prices are asking prices, not completed sales.
exp.title: What KSHETRA does
exp.1.title: AI property valuation
exp.1.body: A price estimate from a model trained on tens of thousands of Indian listings, checked against comparable homes before it reaches you.
exp.2.title: Market intelligence
exp.2.body: See how a locality’s asking price per square foot compares with the rest of the city, and where your flat sits within it.
exp.3.title: Explainable insights
exp.3.body: Each estimate breaks down into the factors behind it, in rupees, so you can see why the number is what it is.
how.title: How it works
how.1.title: Enter property details
how.1.body: City, locality, size and bedrooms are enough. Building name, floor and furnishing sharpen the estimate.
how.2.title: AI analyses market data
how.2.body: The model compares your flat with nearby listings and near-identical flats in the same building.
how.3.title: Receive your valuation report
how.3.body: A value, a likely range, a confidence grade, the factors behind it and the comparables used.
value.title: Estimate a property’s value
value.lead: Apartments in {cities} Indian cities. Nothing you enter here is stored.
ins.title: The market, locality by locality
ins.bars.title: Priciest and most affordable localities
ins.bars.sub: Median asking price per sq ft, localities with 5+ listings
ins.strip.title: Where every locality sits
ins.strip.sub: Each mark is one locality; the line is the city median
ins.fine: These are asking prices from a single snapshot of listings, so they show how localities compare today, not how prices have moved over time.
cta.body: KSHETRA was built for the Hero Housing Fintech Challenge to make home-loan valuations faster and easier to trust. Lenders use the signed-in workspace to send uncertain cases to a human reviewer, with every decision logged.
foot.about: Every land has a story. Every property has a value. Explainable property valuation for Indian housing finance.
foot.privacy: Public estimates are not stored. Lender valuations are kept with an audit trail.
foot.terms: Estimates are based on asking prices and are not a formal valuation or an offer to lend.
foot.translated: Translated automatically with Gemini. Numbers and place names are unchanged.
